description: Generate an interactive HTML visualization using AI and add it to a document. Describe what you want (chart type, data, style) and AI will generate the HTML. Optionally include the document's research context.

documentId.description: The document ID to add the visualization to

includeContext.description: Include document research context in generation (default: true)

prompt.description: Description of the visualization (e.g., 'bar chart comparing revenue of top 5 tech companies in 2025')

sortOrder.description: Position in the document (0-based). Defaults to end.

name: generate_visualization
